cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cupboard has passed my inspection. You may request my assistance with the door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you just hold it while I screw it on?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That is an acceptable use of my time. Say you need me and I'll take the weight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need a pair of hands. It's slipping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine, specifically. I'll allow you to abbreviate that to "I need you" before it hits the floor.

reason: Replace the detached authority clauses with permission to request help and superior control of the acknowledgment. B4's generic hands and slipping door cause A5 the specific abbreviated admission.
